win.regime: long dependency chain, 50 percent same-bank conflicts with older independent requests, accurate criticality labels
win.prediction: critical chain waits fewer cycles than age-first baseline, if added control delay is negligible

no_win.regime: conflict-free bank accesses and independent requests
no_win.prediction: same grant cardinality and no makespan improvement

kill_if: equal-resource urgency-aware baseline matches, or physical delay/area outweighs workload-level benefit
